nodes.label: QMP-Bench: Quantum Many-Body Physics Benchmark
nodes.rationale: First end-to-end research-level benchmark with 100 tasks from 21 high-impact articles; covers tensor networks (dmrg), neural quantum states (nqs), quantum circuits (qsim), and DFT (dft)

nodes.label: PhysVEC: Verifiable and Self-Correcting AI Physicist Framework
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent framework with Author, Programming verifier, and Scientific verifier; enforces self-verification and error correction for both code correctness and physical validity

nodes.label: Author Agent
nodes.rationale: Analyzes research papers and generates structured scripts with modular element functions; enables systematic verification and efficient error correction

nodes.label: Programming Verifier
nodes.rationale: Conducts unit tests and integration tests to ensure programming correctness; achieves near-100% executability through parallel error correction

nodes.label: Scientific Verifier
nodes.rationale: Performs rubric tests, physical assertion tests, and convergence tests to ensure physical validity; provides human-auditable evidence of correctness

nodes.label: Unit Tests for Element Functions
nodes.rationale: Examines each element function in isolation using verifier library; reveals programming errors within target functions

nodes.label: Integration Tests for Hierarchical Execution
nodes.rationale: Decomposes computation into levels and executes incrementally; identifies compatibility issues between element functions

nodes.label: Rubric Test for Physical System Validation
nodes.rationale: Checks script against human-curated scorecard covering physical system, computational method, and parameter correctness

nodes.label: Physical Assertion Test
nodes.rationale: Validates script against predefined physical constraints: limiting case tests, symmetry tests, and analytical tests

nodes.label: Convergence Test
nodes.rationale: Progressively increases computational accuracy parameters to ensure numerical convergence of results

nodes.label: LLM Hallucinations in Scientific Research
nodes.rationale: Critical barrier to AI-driven discovery; includes domain-specific errors in code syntax and physical configurations; requires systematic verification mechanisms

nodes.label: Verifier Library for Unit Tests
nodes.rationale: Repository of verified element functions distilled from official package repositories; provides test environments for systematic verification

hyperedges.label: Verification and Error Correction Pipeline
hyperedges.rationale: Multi-stage pipeline ensuring both programming correctness and physical validity; addresses hallucinations through systematic verification
